# select_alert_integration (Data Source)

Finds an alert integration of any type, Slack included. Use its id as the `integration_id` of an alert destination. The filters must match exactly one integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find the Slack integration for one workspace. Connect Slack in the SELECT UI
# first.
data "select_alert_integration" "slack" {
  integration_type     = "slack"
  slack_workspace_name = "Acme"
}

resource "select_slack_alert_destination" "alerts" {
  integration_id = data.select_alert_integration.slack.id
  channel        = "cost-alerts"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_type` (String) `slack`, `email` or `ms_teams_webhook`.

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Keep only the integration with this display name. Must match exactly.
- `slack_workspace_name` (String) Keep only the Slack integration for this workspace. Must match exactly.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) When the integration was connected — RFC 3339 UTC.
- `credentials_configured` (Boolean) Whether SELECT holds credentials for this integration.
- `etag` (String) Opaque strong ETag for this integration.
- `id` (String) The integration's identifier in SELECT.
- `slack_workspace_id` (String) The id of the connected Slack workspace. Null for other types.
- `status` (String) The status of SELECT's connection: `unknown`, `pending`, `failing` or `connected`.
- `update_time` (String) When the integration was last changed — RFC 3339 UTC.
